book.name: 1 Corinth
book.title: Paul Fus Letta Ta Dem Een Corinth

content: De People wa da Do God Wok

Me Christian bredren, A ain been able fa taak ta oona same like A taak ta people dat leh God Sperit rule oba um. A been haffa taak ta oona same like A taak ta people wa leh ting een dis wol rule oba um, like leetle chullun wa ain ondastan Christ way yet.
E stan like A beena gii oona milk fa drink. A ain gii oona meat fa nyam, cause oona ain been ready fa dat yet. An oona ain ready fa um eben now.

Oona keep on da lib like oona leh ting ob dis wol rule oba oona. Oona wahn wa oda people got an aagy wid one noda an ain gree togeda. Dat show dat oona da lib like oona leh ting ob dis wol rule oba oona, ainty? Fa true oona da do jes like people een dis wol.
Some ob oona say, “A da do wa Paul say.” An noda say, “A da do wa Apollos say.” Dat show fa true dat oona da do jes like people ob dis wol, ainty?
Atta all, who Apollos? Who Paul? We jes God saabant dat beena taak bout God ta oona so dat oona come fa bleebe pon Jedus. Apollos an me, each one ob we jes da do de wok dat God gii we fa do.
A beena plant de seed een oona haat. Apollos wata um. Bot God de one dat mek de plant grow.
So den, de one wa plant de seed an de one wa wata um, dey all two ain nottin. God de one wa count mo den all, cause e da mek de plant grow.
De one wa plant an de one wa wata, all two wok fa de same ting. An God gwine gii ebrybody e pay fa de wok e done.
Cause we paatna, fa do God wok togeda. An oona stan like fiel dat God da wok. Oona stan too like house dat God da build.
God mek um so dat A been able fa do de wok fa be de massa builda wa got sense. A done pit down de solid groun. Noda poson da build pontop um. Bot ebry poson mus tek cyah how e da build.
Jedus Christ de onliest solid groun. Ain nobody able fa pit down no oda solid groun.
Now den, wen people da build pontop dis yah solid groun, some ob um been nyuse gole, silba or fine stone. Oda people kin nyuse wood, hay or straw fa build.

Ebrybody gwine know de kind ob wok, good or bad, dat ebrybody done wen e beena build. Dey gwine know how people done, wen de day come wen God gwine jedge all people. Dat gwine show ebrybody bout um. Cause dat de day wen de fire gwine show jes wa kind ob wok ebry poson done. Dat fire gwine test um fa see ef e done good wok, or ef e wok bad.
Ef wa a poson done build pontop de solid groun ain bun op een de fire, God gwine gim e payback fa e wok.
Bot ef wa a poson done build git bun op een de fire, dat poson gwine loss out. E gwine be sabe, bot e gwine come out like somebody wa been fa bun eenside a fire bot jes haadly git out.
Fa sho, oona know dat oona God own house an God Sperit da lib eenside oona, ainty dough?
Ef a poson stroy God own house, God gwine stroy dat poson. Cause dat God own house wa blongst ta um dat de poson stroy. An fa true, oona God own house.

Mus dohn none ob oona bleebe wa ain true. Ef one mongst oona tink e got sense, coddin ta people ob dis wol, e mus pit way e own sense an be like a fool wa ain mek no sense, so dat e kin git sense fa true.

Cause wa de people ob dis wol tink mek sense, dat ain mek no sense tall een God eye. Like dey write een God Book say, “De Lawd da ketch dem wa nyuse dey own sense een dis wol an trap um een dey foxy way.”
An dey write gin say, “De people dat got sense jes coddin ta dis wol, de Lawd know dat wa dey da study bout ain wot nottin.”
So den, ain nobody oughta brag bout wa people kin do. Ain nottin dat ain blongst ta oona.
Paul, Apollos, an Peter, dis wol, an life an det, dem ting wa dey yah now an dem wa gwine come fa be bye an bye, all dem blongst ta oona.
An oona blongst ta Christ, an Christ blongst ta God.
